components.purpose: Triggers an action, usually an ontology method.
useWhen: The person runs a method or confirms a step
avoidWhen: Navigating to another place: use a link

isDisabled.description: Not available. Prefer hiding methods that are not valid

icon.description: An icon from the catalog's Icon names, shown before the label, or alone in a plain button

aria-label.description: The button's name when it shows only an icon

isInline.description: Sits in a line of text, for a link button such as a linked object

components.responsive: Inline at every width. Use isBlock for a full-width action in narrow containers.
accessibility: Always has a visible label
Disabled buttons must say why elsewhere in the view
A button that shows only an icon has an aria-label, and a Tooltip with the same words

examples.because: Assess is valid: workflow is triaged

components.purpose: Shows a short category or status.
useWhen: Showing an object's state or category
components.responsive: Fixed size. Several labels wrap onto new lines.
accessibility: Status is shown with status, which adds an icon, never color alone (rule 4)

components.purpose: Shows a count.
useWhen: A number of items, such as unread notifications

screenReaderText.description: What the count means, for screen readers

components.responsive: Fixed size at every width.
accessibility: Give screenReaderText when the number alone is unclear

components.purpose: Shows a PatternFly icon, sized and colored by status.
avoidWhen: As the only carrier of meaning without a label

aria-label.description: Name it when the icon carries meaning

components.responsive: Fixed size at every width.
accessibility: Decorative unless aria-label is set
Never the only signal of status (rule 4)

components.purpose: Single-line text entry.
useWhen: A method needs a short text input

aria-label.description: Name of the field. Required until the Form group molecule is in the catalog

components.responsive: Fills the width of its container.
accessibility: Always has a name
Error state is explained in text, not color alone

components.purpose: Turns one option on or off, often one of several.
avoidWhen: A setting that applies at once: use Switch
components.responsive: Label wraps at narrow widths.
accessibility: Always has a visible label

components.purpose: Picks one option from a set.
useWhen: Picking exactly one of a few options

name.description: Group name shared by the set

value.description: The value this option sets, such as an IRI

components.responsive: Label wraps at narrow widths.
accessibility: Always has a visible label
Options in a set share a name

components.purpose: Turns a setting on or off with immediate effect.
useWhen: A setting that applies at once
avoidWhen: Choices submitted with a form: use Checkbox
components.responsive: Label wraps at narrow widths.
accessibility: Always has a visible label

components.purpose: Shows that something is loading.
useWhen: Waiting for a gateway read or method
components.responsive: Fixed size at every width.
accessibility: Announces what is loading

components.purpose: Shows a short hint for the element it wraps.
useWhen: Naming an icon-only control or adding a hint
avoidWhen: Essential information: hard to reach on touch screens
components.responsive: On touch screens it shows on tap or focus. Never the only place for essential information.
accessibility: Opens on keyboard focus as well as hover, so its trigger must be focusable, such as a Button

components.purpose: Separates groups of content.
components.responsive: Can change orientation per breakpoint, for example horizontal when stacked on phones and vertical side by side.
accessibility: Presentational: separates visually, not semantically

components.purpose: Shows a person's picture.

src.description: Image address, read through the gateway

components.responsive: Fixed size at every width.
accessibility: Always has alt text naming the person

components.purpose: A heading.
components.responsive: Wraps at narrow widths.
accessibility: Heading levels follow the outline, never skipped for looks

components.purpose: Body text.

accessibility: Headings use Title, not Content

useWhen: Showing several objects of the same kind side by side

isFullHeight.description: Fills the height of its container, so cards in a row line up

isSelectable.description: Chosen like a radio button, with a field and a value

value.description: The value a selectable card sets its field to when chosen

components.responsive: Full width on phones. In a Gallery or Grid, cards sit side by side as space allows.

components.purpose: The top of a card: its title, and for a selectable card, the radio button that chooses it.
useWhen: A selectable card: the renderer puts its title in a header with the radio button
An object card: its identifier and type in small text, then its title

accessibility: Holds the card's title, which names the radio button of a selectable card

isFilled.description: Takes the remaining height of the card

accessibility: Purely a container

aria-label.description: What the dialog is for, such as the method and the object

components.purpose: The title of a Modal. An action given as its child, such as Minimize, sits beside the close button.

description.description: The object's type, or a short explanation

components.responsive: Wraps at narrow widths.
accessibility: The title names the dialog

components.purpose: The content of a Modal.
components.responsive: Scrolls inside the dialog when tall.
accessibility: Purely a container

components.purpose: The actions of a Modal.

role.description: Set for a group of radio buttons

components.responsive: Full width of its form. Inline radio buttons wrap onto new lines at narrow widths.

components.purpose: Multi-line text entry.
useWhen: A text input of a method

autoResize.description: Grows with its text, so long text such as a narrative can be read and edited whole

components.responsive: Fills the width of its form group and grows vertically.
accessibility: Named by its form group's label and aria-label

components.purpose: Picks one value from a list.

avoidWhen: Five values or fewer: use Radio
components.responsive: Fills the width of its form group.
accessibility: Uses the platform's native select, so it works with every assistive technology

components.purpose: One value of a FormSelect.

value.description: The value, such as an IRI; empty for the placeholder

components.responsive: Fixed.
accessibility: The label describes the value

components.purpose: Shows facts as terms and their values.
useWhen: The preview of what a method will change
components.responsive: Terms stack above their values on phones.
accessibility: Reads as a list of term and value pairs

components.purpose: One term and its value.
components.responsive: Stacks on phones.
accessibility: Purely a container

components.purpose: The term of a fact.
components.responsive: Wraps.
accessibility: Announced as a term

components.purpose: The value of a fact.
components.responsive: Wraps.
accessibility: Announced as the term's value

components.purpose: A message about the outcome of an action, or why it cannot run.

variant.description: Kind of message, shown by icon and color

isInline.description: Inside a form or page section

component.description: The title's element: a heading at the level that fits the page outline, or p where no heading fits

useWhen: Following a background run (archetype Start and track)
avoidWhen: Waits with unknown progress: use Spinner

title.description: What is in progress, and its status

valueText.description: The progress in words, for screen readers

variant.description: How it ended, shown by icon and color

How it ended is shown by an icon as well as color (rule 4)

Run signal detection on P-101: finished

id.description: A stable id for the step

nextButtonText.description: Names the Next button, such as the method on the last step

isNextDisabled.description: Next is disabled until the step is complete

components.purpose: Centers one item horizontally and vertically.
useWhen: Empty states and single centered content
components.responsive: Centers at every width.
accessibility: Purely visual; reading order is the source order

components.purpose: Arranges items in a row or column, with per-breakpoint direction, gap and alignment.
avoidWhen: Two-dimensional grids: use Grid or Gallery
components.responsive: Mobile first: default is the phone layout, for example a column, and larger breakpoints change it, for example to a row.
accessibility: Reverse directions change only the visual order; keep the source order meaningful

components.purpose: An item in a Flex with its own grow behavior.
useWhen: One item needs to grow or shrink differently
avoidWhen: Plain items: put them in Flex directly
components.responsive: Grow behavior can change per breakpoint.
accessibility: Purely visual

components.purpose: A grid of equal-width items that wrap to fit.
useWhen: Collections of similar items, such as cards
components.responsive: Items wrap to fit the width: one column on phones, more as space allows.
accessibility: Reading order is row by row in source order

components.purpose: An item in a Gallery.
components.responsive: Width set by its Gallery.
accessibility: Purely visual

components.purpose: A 12-column grid.
useWhen: Two-dimensional layouts with items of set widths
avoidWhen: Equal items that wrap: use Gallery
components.responsive: Items are full width on phones unless a span says otherwise; spans change per breakpoint.
accessibility: Reading order is source order

components.purpose: An item in a Grid, spanning columns per breakpoint.
components.responsive: Set span for phones (usually 12) and narrower spans at larger breakpoints.
accessibility: Purely visual

components.purpose: Spreads items across a row, such as a heading and its actions.
useWhen: A title on one side and actions on the other
components.responsive: Stacks vertically on phones and becomes a row from md up.
accessibility: Reading order is source order

components.purpose: An item in a Level.
components.responsive: Position set by its Level.
accessibility: Purely visual

components.purpose: Places items side by side, one of which can fill the rest.
useWhen: An item beside a growing item, such as an icon beside text
avoidWhen: Layouts that must stack on phones: use Flex

isWrappable.description: Wrap onto new lines when space runs out

components.responsive: Set isWrappable unless the items always fit at 320px.
accessibility: Reading order is source order

components.purpose: An item in a Split.
components.responsive: Width set by its content or isFilled.
accessibility: Purely visual

components.purpose: Places items in a column.
components.responsive: A column at every width.
accessibility: Reading order is source order

components.purpose: An item in a Stack.
components.responsive: Full width at every width.
accessibility: Purely visual

components.purpose: A PatternFly chart. The renderer sizes it to its container's width, so it is drawn at true size at every width.

avoidWhen: A single number: use a stat tile
Where a table of figures says it better

ariaDesc.description: What the chart shows, in words, with its figures

domain.description: The value range, so several charts share one scale

legendData.description: Legend entries, each a name and the swatch of its color, in mark order

legendAllowWrap.description: Legend entries wrap onto more rows; the renderer grows the chart's height to fit them

components.responsive: As wide as its container at every width, re-measured when the container changes; text is never scaled down.
accessibility: An SVG with a title and description
Never the only way to read a value: the figures are also given as text beside it (rule 4)

components.purpose: Stacks bars end to end, such as the parts of one whole.
useWhen: A segmented bar: one whole split into parts
avoidWhen: Comparing parts with each other: use bars on one baseline
components.responsive: As its chart.
accessibility: Its parts are described by the chart's description

components.purpose: Bars from data, in a chart.
useWhen: A part of a segmented bar, or bars on one baseline

cornerRadius.description: Rounding of the data end (top) and the baseline end (bottom)

fill.description: A chart color token, as var(--pf-t--chart--color--blue--100) to 500

stroke.description: The card surface, so a 2px stroke reads as a gap between segments

components.responsive: As its chart.
accessibility: Colors come only from chart tokens, and identity is never color alone

eventKey.description: The tab's key, the value its Tabs field takes when it is chosen

count.description: How many objects the tab lists, shown as a badge after the title
